extracted.intended_audience: prospective grantees, nonprofit organizations, researchers, institutions, and others seeking Packard Foundation funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing the Packard Foundation's vision, mission, goals, values, program initiatives, and institutional commitments to help prospective applicants understand what the Foundation funds and how it approaches grantmaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Vision: A just and equitable world where people and nature flourish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation’s vision frames all funding decisions — projects should contribute to a world where people and nature flourish.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with people and communities to create enduring solutions for just societies and a healthy, resilient natural world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding should align with collaborative, community-centered approaches that produce enduring solutions for justice and environmental resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal — Build just societies
rubrics_metrics.description: We support a strong civil society and inclusive institutions and governance to build just and equitable societies for all people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for work that strengthens civil society, inclusive institutions, and governance that advance justice and equity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal — Protect and restore our natural world
rubrics_metrics.description: We champion bold climate solutions, an ocean that sustains us, and scientific innovation and discovery to secure the health and future of people and planet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports ambitious climate action, ocean conservation, and science-led approaches to secure planetary and human health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal — Invest in families and communities
rubrics_metrics.description: We prioritize the importance of children having a healthy start and promoting resilient and vibrant communities where children and families thrive, so they have the power to shape their lives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds programs that promote early childhood health and family/community resilience enabling children and families to thrive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — Belief in Individual Leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Belief in Individual Leadership: We promote an environment of trust and flexibility, recognizing that people with diverse backgrounds, their ideas, and their efforts are at the center of change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports grantees and leaders, values trust and flexible partnerships, and centers diverse leadership as a driver of change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — Effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Effectiveness: We strive for meaningful impact. We evaluate and adapt our work in partnership with communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes measurable, meaningful impact and iterative evaluation done in partnership with communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: Equity: We strive for equity in all we do in pursuit of a more just world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should demonstrate an equity focus across design and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrity: We are open and honest, hold ourselves accountable, and adhere to the highest standards of conduct and ethics in all we do.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectations for transparent, ethical conduct and accountability from partners and grantees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — Respect
rubrics_metrics.description: Respect: We show respect for all people. We value and listen deeply to diverse perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes respectful engagement and authentic inclusion of diverse perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — Thinking Big
rubrics_metrics.description: Thinking Big: We encourage and support big ideas where a large, long-term commitment of resources can make a significant contribution to enduring change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Favors ambitious, long-term investments that aim for systemic or enduring change rather than short-term, incremental fixes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — California Communities Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: California Communities Initiative — Promoting a Strong and Resilient California.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding priority focused on strengthening California communities and resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — Children and Families Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Children and Families Initiative — Supporting Healthy Moms and Kids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports programs aimed at maternal and child health and family wellbeing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — Civil Society and Leadership Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Civil Society and Leadership Initiative — Fostering a Thriving Civil Society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds work that strengthens civil society, leadership, and civic capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — Democracy, Rights, and Governance Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Democracy, Rights, and Governance Initiative — Advancing a Thriving, Resilient Democracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes efforts to protect and strengthen democratic systems, rights, and governance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — Global Climate Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Global Climate Initiative — Ending Tropical Deforestation for People and Climate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports strategies to end tropical deforestation with co-benefits for people and climate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — Global Reproductive Health Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Global Reproductive Health Initiative — Advancing Reproductive Health and Rights Globally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds work that advances reproductive health and rights on a global scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — Ocean Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Ocean Initiative — Ensuring a Healthy Ocean for Nature and People.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on ocean conservation and sustainable ocean stewardship benefiting ecosystems and communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — U.S. Racial Justice Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. Racial Justice Initiative — Advancing Racial Justice in the U.S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes programs that address structural racial inequities and advance racial justice domestically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative — U.S. Reproductive Health Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. Reproductive Health Initiative — Advancing Reproductive Health and Rights in the U.S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds U.S.-focused work to protect and expand reproductive health and rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: Honoring long-term commitments to institutions that are core to our legacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation maintains enduring, legacy commitments to certain institutions as part of its portfolio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packard Fellowships for Science and Engineering
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing most promising early-career scientists and engineers flexible funding to take risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports early-career investigators with flexible fellowships intended to enable high-risk, potentially high-reward research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission Investing
rubrics_metrics.description: Expanding the impact of our grantmaking through loans and equity investments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation uses mission investing (loans and equity) as a tool to expand impact beyond traditional grants.
